This page presents recorded validation evidence. The browser requests exercise the actual authenticated rating API. Screenshots below show the existing web playback regression with generated media. They do not show native Compose rating controls, which still need physical-device focus and accessibility acceptance.

What the application verified

  • Preference round-trips for Like, Love, Not for me and No rating.
  • Foreign profiles, locked profiles and undelivered client contexts are rejected.
  • Catalogue annotations and recommendation/Home revisions follow the active profile's preference.
  • Watched state, progress, watchlists and hidden titles remain independent.
  • Account login, profile selection, PIN verification, decoded frames and persisted playback progress work.
  • The mobile audio/subtitle sheet opens and closes within the viewport after layout transitions settle.

Scope and remaining acceptance

The demo lacks external metadata/provider keys, producing the documented top-ten and movie-detail errors. Generated cached media still plays. This does not establish real Usenet cold-start performance or p95 latency. Curated child profiles retain their restrictions; external rating import and write synchronization remain off. Native device rendering and the separate Watch web-client rating control remain outstanding.

All fixture accounts and media inputs are synthetic. The artifacts contain no private playlist or credentials. These checks did not deploy to production or merge upstream.
